final.title: Spot trial expiry before it becomes a surprise
final.body:
If you run a small business, spotting trial expiry early is not a grand AI project. It is a simple workflow decision: when should the reminder fire, and who should see it first?

Start with one diagnostic question. Are your trial dates already in one place—calendar, email, spreadsheet, or CRM—or are they scattered across vendor accounts? If they are already central, a light reminder rule may be enough. If they are scattered, you may need a small integration rather than a full rethink.

Keep the human in charge. Automation should surface the date; the owner still decides whether to renew, downgrade, or cancel. That keeps money movement and other high-risk decisions with a person, where they belong. AI can flag the deadline. It should not quietly choose the plan for you. That is a fast way to buy the wrong thing.

A practical next step is to list every SaaS trial you are using and note which tool, if any, already tracks the renewal date. That inventory tells you whether the job is simple monitoring or a bounded automation worth building inside your own environment.
